caption:
How to plan a 4-week promotion for your small business in one AI prompt

It's easy to announce an offer once and hope. A plan with a build-up does the work for you.

Copy this:

"Plan a 4-week promotion for [OFFER] at [BUSINESS]. Last orders: [DATE]. Week by week: the goal, 2 post ideas, 1 email, 1 in-store action. Build up to the final week. Keep it doable for one person with a few hours a week."

For an invented bakery's holiday cookie boxes it laid out: tease, launch, remind, last call. Each week had posts, one email and something to do at the counter.

Tip: start from your last-orders date and work back. It gives every week a job.

Send this to someone who still plans promotions the night before. Follow @nomorebusywork for one fix a day.

Save this for later. 📌
